# Hivemind

> A stigmergic shared episodic memory for a fleet of AI coding agents on one codebase,
> exposed as one self-hosted MCP server over HTTP. Agents coordinate with no direct
> communication — each leaves traces (memories) others recall — behind a never-hallucinate
> abstention gate. Single-tenant, single-host, one SQLite store, a CPU-only embedder baked
> into the image (offline at runtime).

Operated through the `hive` CLI; consumed by agents over eight `hive_*` MCP tools. If you can
load only one file, read `llms-full.txt` — it is the complete guide and assumes no prior context.

## Documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): The complete, self-contained operating guide — idea, architecture, trust lifecycle, recall, the eight MCP tools, identity, setup (solo → remote team), KPIs, configuration, and agent working procedure.
- [README.md](README.md): Quickstart from a clone — requirements, `hive up`, connecting local and remote agents, the two-door auth model, configuration, and repository layout.
- [HIVE-ADMIN.md](HIVE-ADMIN.md): Admin & operator guide — first-time setup, tunneling, tuning the recall/safety knobs, KPIs, and day-2 operations (incl. `hive ingest` for census change-outcome receipts).

## Operator runbooks

- [skills/README.md](skills/README.md): Index of the runnable operator skills (bringup, connect-team, backup-restore, operate) for the load-bearing `hive` operations.
- [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md): Long-form operations reference and the tuning evidence behind the KPI thresholds.
